handoff: G1-G9 verified fixed. One blocking: new T9 sentence says local rerun --step/--reset is always refused, but it is refused only when the branch's last boundary names Norn-Next (human.ts:132-135,421-424); otherwise checked via the ref. One-clause fix. Minors: S4 GR6 merge trailers, rejected-push merge has only Norn-Tick (pre-existing), isIntakeCommit overlap, older-norn limitation unreachable, orient launcher dir. Tests green.

findings.title: T9: rerun --step/--reset is refused only when the last boundary names a step
findings.detail:
The new sentence says the refusal is unconditional under local. But the stepOnly builder, which throws story_not_local (packages/cli/src/commands/run-rerun.ts:33-37), runs only when the target carries a boundary: packages/cli/src/runtime/human.ts:421-424 `if (target.boundary) { ... receipt = stepOnly(target, target.boundary.next)`. That boundary is set only when the story branch has a last boundary with Norn-Next (human.ts:132-135 `if (b?.next)`). With no such boundary, the target comes from the record ref (human.ts:138-141) and --step/--reset are checked against that ref's pinned workflow (run-rerun.ts:45-63). The sentence just before it says the same about where the cursor comes from.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add 'when its last boundary names the step it led to (the case above)' to the refusal sentence.

findings.title: S4: the GR6 base-record commit also carries the merge trailers
findings.detail:
packages/cli/src/runtime/record.ts:40-45 adds Norn-Merge-Commit, Norn-Merged-By and Norn-Merged-At when the merge facts are known. The sentence reads correctly as 'of S4's trailers, only Norn-Story and Norn-Tick'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say 'of these trailers, only Norn-Story and Norn-Tick (plus the merge trailers)'.

findings.title: S4: the merge commit after a rejected branch push carries only Norn-Tick
findings.detail:
act.pushBranch is called with no trailers (packages/cli/src/runtime/act/git-step.ts:56,109,114,124). takeRemoteBranch (act/env.ts:191,214) then merges with `{ ...trailers, "Norn-Tick" }`, so the commit has no Norn-Story or Norn-Step. S4's opening sentence on the base branch already missed this. It is arguably a code gap (the push should pass the unit's trailers) rather than a wording one.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Pass the unit's trailers into pushBranch in a later story, or name this commit in S4.

findings.title: S4: decide commits made with no cursor also lack Norn-Step and Norn-Slice, so isIntakeCommit matches them too
findings.detail:
The mirror (decide/story.ts:347), refine-finished (:309) and B34 move (:226) commits pass `?.step ?? null`. The policy.ts:184 check therefore also matches them; reset.ts:32 takes the newest match. This is latent, not something the docs claim.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: File as a follow-up.

findings.title: The older-norn-only branch case is not reachable as worded
findings.detail:
A branch holding only an older norn's commits still has runs/ in its tree, so lostRecord returns null (checkout.ts:252) and the tick moves the run state (B34). What can happen is a branch after the B34 move with no boundary since. That also restarts at the first step.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Reword it as 'no boundary since the move off the branch'.

findings.title: An orient agent's launcher is in ~/.norn/orient/launch/, not ~/.norn/launch/
findings.detail:
packages/cli/src/runtime/shim.ts:54 puts the launcher dir at dirname(dirname(shim)).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name both launcher dirs.

findings.title: 'a repo with no remote base' is really 'no fetched base ref'
findings.detail:
base.ts:24-48 and doctor.ts:356-359 check for a fetched refs/remotes/<remote>/<base> whose tree has a specs dir.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional wording.

findings.title: The story reopen commit also carries take
findings.detail:
story-reopen.ts:128 reuses checkout's journal commit (checkout.ts:546-550).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional.
